Thought: Looking at the IR spectrum, I can see a peak at 1723 cm⁻¹, which is in the characteristic region for carbonyl groups (C=O stretch typically appears around 1670-1820 cm⁻¹). This indicates the presence of one carbonyl group in the molecule.

To be thorough, I can also check the carbon NMR to confirm this finding, as carbonyl carbons typically appear around 160-220 ppm.
Action: carbon_nmr_spectra
Action Input: {}

Thought: The carbon NMR data confirms the presence of one carbonyl group. There is a peak at 196.80 ppm, which is in the typical range for carbonyl carbons (160-220 ppm). This corroborates with the IR data showing a carbonyl stretch at 1723 cm⁻¹.

Both pieces of spectral evidence consistently show that there is exactly one carbonyl group in the molecule.
